description_en: Sets the access mode for website services
description_zh: 设置网站业务的接入模式
name: ModifyWebAccessMode

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website service.
The domain name must have forwarding rules configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The access mode for website services. Valid values:
0: A record
1: Anti-DDoS Pro mode
2: Back-to-origin mode
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的接入模式。取值：
0：A记录
1：高防模式
2：回源模式
parameters.name: access_mode

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
